abilities.name: Command Re-Roll
abilities.community_notes: Re-roll one Advance, Charge, Damage, Hazard, Hit, Save or Wound roll, or a roll determining a weapon's number of attacks, just after making it; for multi-dice rolls re-roll one chosen die, except Charge rolls which are re-rolled in full

abilities.name: Counteroffensive
abilities.community_notes: Used in the Fight step just after an enemy unit resolves its attacks: your unit gains Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight

abilities.name: Crushing Impact
abilities.community_notes: Monster/Vehicle unit after a Charge move: select one engaged enemy unit and one engaged model in your unit, roll D6 equal to that model's Toughness — each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the enemy unit (max 6), and each 1 inflicts 1 mortal wound on your own unit

abilities.name: Epic Challenge
abilities.community_notes: Used when a Character unit is selected to fight: one Character model's melee weapons gain [PRECISION]

abilities.name: Explosives
abilities.community_notes: One unengaged Explosives/Grenades unit that is eligible to shoot and did not Advance: select one such model and one unengaged enemy unit within 8" and visible to it, then roll six D6 — each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound

abilities.name: Fire Overwatch
abilities.community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Movement phase, one friendly unengaged unit (excluding Titanic) shoots using snap shooting

abilities.name: Heroic Intervention
abilities.community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Charge phase, one friendly unengaged unit within 12" of enemy units resolves a charge (Vehicles only if Character/Walker); a mode is selected before the charge roll, e.g. Leap to Defend restricts targets to units that charged this phase within maximum distance

abilities.name: Insane Bravery
abilities.community_notes: Used just before making a Battle-shock roll for the unit: that roll is automatically successful. Once per battle

abilities.name: Rapid Ingress
abilities.community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Movement phase, one friendly unit in Strategic Reserves (excluding Aircraft) makes an ingress move. Cannot be used in the first battle round

abilities.name: Smokescreen
abilities.community_notes: At the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, one friendly Smoke unit: attacks targeting it — or targeting units not fully visible because of its models — have the target benefiting from cover

abilities.name: Boundless Zeal
abilities.community_notes: The unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back; Penitent units are eligible to shoot and declare a charge instead.

abilities.name: Devout Fanaticism
abilities.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your unit.

abilities.name: Final Redemption
abilities.community_notes: Used on a Penitent unit that was just destroyed while within range of an objective marker you controlled: that objective remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at the end of a phase.

abilities.name: Lash of Guilt
abilities.community_notes: Used just before the unit Advances. Penitent Engines units do not make an Advance roll; instead add 6" to their Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

abilities.name: Passion of the Penitent
abilities.community_notes: Only attacks made by Penitent models in the unit benefit.

abilities.name: Purity of Suffering
abilities.community_notes: Only Penitent models in the unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.community_notes: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice when using this Stratagem; the model returns with D3 wounds remaining plus 1 per Miracle dice discarded (up to its starting wounds), unengaged, not part of an Attached unit, with a Starting Strength of 1. Saint Celestine cannot be selected; the same Character cannot be selected more than once per battle.

abilities.name: Praise the Fallen
abilities.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot and destroyed one or more models in your unit; your unit must target only that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target.

abilities.name: Sanctified Immolation
abilities.community_notes: Used on a Vehicle model with the Deadly Demise ability that was just destroyed: do not roll for Deadly Demise; mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Martyr
abilities.community_notes: Each destroyed model that has not fought this phase fights after the attacking unit finishes its attacks and is then removed from play.

abilities.name: Suffering and Sacrifice
abilities.community_notes: Used at the start of the Fight phase on one Infantry or Walker unit: until the end of the phase, each enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit must select your unit as the target of its attacks.

abilities.name: Blazing Ire
abilities.community_notes: Used in your opponent's Shooting phase just after an enemy unit has shot at your Transport: one embarked unit can disembark as if it were your Movement phase, then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only the attacking enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

abilities.name: Carry Forth the Faithful
abilities.community_notes: Used just before the Transport Advances: re-roll its Advance rolls, and units can disembark from it even though it Advanced. Units that do so count as having made a Normal move and cannot declare a charge this turn.

abilities.name: Cleansing Flames
abilities.community_notes: Targets one unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase; only Torrent weapons gain [Devastating Wounds].

abilities.name: Righteous Blows
abilities.community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by those weapons this phase, one destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Rites of Fire
abilities.community_notes: Ranged attacks only, against enemy units within 6" that are also within range of an objective marker (target conditions not encoded). If enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, one destroyed model's unit must take a Battle-shock test (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Shield of Aversion
abilities.community_notes: Lasts until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks.

abilities.name: Bastion of Faith
abilities.community_notes: If your unit is Righteous, you can also select one other Celestian Sacresants unit (not Battle-shocked, within 6") to receive the same protection (extension not encoded).

abilities.name: Indefatigable Dedication
abilities.community_notes: Used just after the unit Falls Back. If the unit is Righteous, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back instead (escalation not encoded).

abilities.name: Path of the Righteous
abilities.community_notes: If the unit is Righteous, those moves do not need to end closer to the closest enemy model, provided they end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (relaxation not encoded).

abilities.name: Shield of Denial
abilities.community_notes: Used just after a mortal wound is allocated to the unit. If the unit is Righteous, the Feel No Pain is 5+ against mortal wounds instead (escalation not encoded).

abilities.name: Suffer Not the Unfaithful
abilities.community_notes: The unit must be Righteous and not have been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

abilities.name: To the Heart of Heresy
abilities.community_notes: If the unit is Righteous, also improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee weapons by 1 until the end of the phase (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Angelic Descent
abilities.community_notes: Used at the end of your opponent's Fight phase: remove the unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Blinding Radiance
abilities.community_notes: Targets one Infantry unit that was selected as a target, or one friendly Jump Pack unit within 3" of such a unit. If a Jump Pack unit was targeted, friendly Infantry units within 3" of it also impose -1 to Hit (extension not encoded).

abilities.name: Divine Guidance
abilities.community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Faith and Fury
abilities.community_notes: If one or more enemy models are destroyed by the unit's attacks this phase, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Light of the Emperor
abilities.community_notes: The blessed unit can ignore modifiers to its models' profile characteristics, its weapons' WS/BS, and any roll or test made for it (excluding saving throw modifiers). If the unit has the Jump Pack keyword, friendly Adepta Sororitas units within 3" are also blessed (extension not encoded).

abilities.name: Fervent Devotion
abilities.community_notes: Used when the unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move: that move does not prevent it from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge.

abilities.name: Fires of Damnation
abilities.community_notes: Used when the unit is selected to shoot or fight: its Torrent weapons have an Attacks characteristic of 6, and all of its attacks improve their Armour Penetration by 1.

abilities.name: Take Cover
abilities.community_notes: Used when an enemy unit targets your unit while it is within a terrain area; Arco-flagellants units cannot be selected.

abilities.name: Psalm of Righteous Judgement
abilities.community_notes: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a Penitent unit from your army, you can discard 1 Miracle dice and then gain 1 Miracle dice showing a value of 6.

abilities.name: Verse of Holy Piety
abilities.community_notes: Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, select one Vow of Atonement (see the Desperate for Redemption detachment rule): until the start of the next battle round it is active for the bearer's unit in addition to any active for your army, even if already selected this battle.

abilities.name: Catechism of Divine Penitence
abilities.community_notes: Canoness, Palatine or Ministorum Priest model only.

abilities.name: Saintly Example
abilities.community_notes: When the bearer is destroyed, you gain an additional D3 Miracle dice.

abilities.name: Through Suffering, Strength
abilities.community_notes: If the bearer has lost one or more wounds, the bonus is +2 to each characteristic instead (escalation not encoded).

abilities.name: Chaplet of Sacrifice
abilities.community_notes: At the end of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, re-roll 1 Miracle dice from your pool and return it showing the new result; if the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, re-roll up to 3 Miracle dice instead.

abilities.name: Mantle of Ophelia
abilities.community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only: each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1.

abilities.name: Righteous Rage
abilities.community_notes: Each time the bearer is selected to fight, you can first discard up to 3 Miracle dice; the bonus is +1 Attacks and +1 Strength per die discarded.

abilities.name: Manual of Saint Griselda
abilities.community_notes: At the start of your Command phase, you can discard up to 2 Miracle dice; the gained Miracle dice shows a value equal to the sum of the discarded dice (maximum 6).

abilities.name: Fire and Fury
abilities.community_notes: Torrent weapons get +1 Attacks; all other ranged weapons in the led unit have [Sustained Hits 1].

abilities.name: Iron Surplice of Saint Istalela
abilities.community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only.

abilities.name: Triptych of Judgement
abilities.community_notes: Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can ignore modifiers to that attack's BS/WS and/or modifiers to the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Mark of Devotion
abilities.community_notes: While the bearer's unit is Righteous, the bonus is +2 Attacks and +1 Damage instead (escalation not encoded).

abilities.name: Eyes of the Oracle
abilities.community_notes: The bearer's weapons have [Precision]; each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy Character model, you gain 1CP.

abilities.name: Litanies of Faith
abilities.community_notes: Canoness or Palatine model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, take a Leadership test for it; the Miracle dice is gained only if the test is passed (gate not encoded).

abilities.name: Blade of Saint Ellynor
abilities.community_notes: Each time the bearer fights, if one or more enemy models are destroyed by those attacks, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Divine Aspect
abilities.community_notes: In your Movement phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; it must take a Battle-shock test. If the test is failed, you gain 1 Miracle dice (rider not encoded).

abilities.name: Triptych of the Macharian Crusade
abilities.community_notes: Applies only to saving throws substituted with an Act of Faith: that saving throw is successful irrespective of the value of the Miracle dice used.

abilities.name: Divine Miracle
abilities.community_notes: Upgrade for a Sanctuary Guardians Battle Sisters Squad unit: once per battle, at the start of any phase, the unit heals D3+2 wounds.

abilities.name: Righteous Fervour
abilities.community_notes: The bearer's melee attacks have +1 Damage; the bearer's unit adds 1 to Wound rolls for melee attacks.

abilities.name: Pulse Onslaught
abilities.community_notes: The selected enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) hit by this unit's attacks is shaken until the end of your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: The Grisly Feast

abilities.name: A Tempting Trap

abilities.name: Gift of Change

abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Only the unit's CHARACTER models' melee attacks gain the chosen benefit; modeled unit-wide.

abilities.name: Blood Tithe
abilities.community_notes: Earn side: 1 BTP on a 3+ each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a Blood Legions/World Eaters unit. Spend side (start of your Command phase, effects last until end of battle) references the four detachment abilities by id: enraged-abjuration (2), daemonic-rage (3), boon-of-blood (4), might-of-khorne (5).

abilities.name: Enraged Abjuration
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Applies to BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models only; modeled as all friendly units (keyword-OR gate not expressible). Blood Tithe spend (2 BTP): the start-of-Command-phase activation timing and until-end-of-battle duration come from the parent Blood Tithe rule ('At the start of the Command phase, you can spend... to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle'), not from this option's own text.

abilities.name: Daemonic Rage
abilities.community_notes: Blood Tithe spend (3 BTP), activated at the start of your Command phase, lasting until end of battle: melee weapons equipped by Blood Legions units gain [LANCE].

abilities.name: Boon of Blood
abilities.community_notes: Blood Tithe spend (4 BTP), activated at the start of your Command phase, lasting until end of battle: Blood Legions units have a 4+ invulnerable save. Referenced by blessing-of-burning-blood as the 'Boon of Blood active' condition.

abilities.name: Might of Khorne
abilities.community_notes: Blood Tithe spend (5 BTP), activated at the start of your Command phase, lasting until end of battle: Blood Legions units gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.

abilities.name: Idols of Khorne
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The aura reaches 9" from TITANIC bearers (modeled at the 6" base), and each Idol may only be selected once per battle (per-option limit not modeled).

abilities.name: Favoured of Khorne

abilities.name: Unleash Hell
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The suppressed unit must have been hit by the selected vehicle's attacks and the vehicle is chosen within 6" of the bearer (or is its transport); the hit-gate and the 6" pick are not modeled.

abilities.name: Disciple of Khorne

abilities.community_notes: Melee weapons get +1 A/S/D; each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in melee you automatically gain 1 Blood Tithe point (no 3+ roll needed).

abilities.name: Malicious Vigour
abilities.community_notes: Each Brazen Fury move made by the bearer's unit counts as having rolled a 6 for its distance.

abilities.name: Archslaughterer
abilities.community_notes: WORLD EATERS model only. Once per battle, per army, in your Command phase: every Blessing of Khorne is active for this unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Gateways to Glory
abilities.community_notes: WORLD EATERS DAEMON PRINCE model only: the bearer has MOBILE and adds 1 to Charge rolls.

abilities.name: Hack and Slash
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The unit must have made a Charge move this turn and must not yet have been selected to fight this phase; both preconditions are left out of the effect tree so the stratagem stays a toggleable lever for the cruncher.

abilities.name: Frenzied Resilience
abilities.community_notes: reactive: used just after an enemy unit selects your unit as a target in the Fight phase

abilities.name: Blood Offering
abilities.community_notes: the objective marker remains yours until your opponent's Level of Control over it exceeds yours at the end of a phase; usable even though the unit was just destroyed

abilities.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne!
abilities.community_notes: used just after your unit destroys a CHARACTER or MONSTER model; the extra Blessing is active in addition to any currently active Blessings

abilities.name: Berzerker's Wrath
abilities.community_notes: replaces the D6 surge-move roll: models move up to 8" instead

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Horde
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Targets one JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range (the keyword-OR target and the not-yet-fought precondition are not modeled).

abilities.name: Bloody Vengeance
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The marked unit must be the enemy unit that just destroyed your MONSTER/TITANIC (modeled as selecting one enemy unit).

abilities.name: Brazen Idol
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The selected Idol is active for this unit instead of any other active Idol and may repeat an already-used Idol; the grant_type slugs are display labels for the three Idols of Khorne auras (see idols-of-khorne), not ability_id references.

abilities.name: In the Shadow of Brass Idols
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] the 5+ also applies within 9" of a friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit; usable in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects your JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit as a target

abilities.name: Endless Pursuit of Violence
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The unit must be WHOLLY within 6" of the selected transport (modeled as within 6"), and the transport must be one it is able to embark within.

abilities.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The Rhino must not have been selected to move this phase (precondition not modeled). The disembarking unit sets up wholly within 6" of the Rhino and may be placed within Engagement Range.

abilities.name: Unrelenting Advance

abilities.name: Fury Unleashed
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] used just after an enemy unit shoots a WORLD EATERS RHINO with wounds remaining: one embarked KHORNE BERZERKERS unit makes the disembark move then the surge move; cannot be combined with Unrelenting Advance in the same phase

abilities.name: Blessing of Burning Blood
abilities.community_notes: 5+ invulnerable save until end of phase, improving to 4+ while the Boon of Blood ability (Blood Tithe, Khorne Daemonkin) is active. The source targets a Blood Legions unit within 6" of the attacked World Eaters unit but buffs that World Eaters unit; the DSL target vocabulary can't express that relay, so target is the unit the ability resolves on.

abilities.name: A Worthy Skull
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The follow-on 'spend one or more BTP to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities' is modeled as an unquantified resource-spend without naming the activated ability.

abilities.name: Summoned by Slaughter
abilities.community_notes: Set up a Bloodletters unit from Reserves wholly within 9" of the destroyed model and more than 6" from enemy units, once per battle round. Modeled with resurrection — the local blood-legions summon pattern (cf. daemontide); the Reserves origin, 9"/>6" placement, and once-per-battle-round limit are recorded here rather than in the effect shape.

abilities.name: Daemontide
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Destroyed CHARACTER models cannot be returned to Attached units (restriction not modeled). Returned models go to one BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6" of the stratagem's target.

abilities.name: Murder-call
abilities.community_notes: the unit must be on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of enemy units

abilities.name: Daemonic Strength
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] EIGHTBOUND get the bonus against targets that are not MONSTERS or VEHICLES; EXALTED EIGHTBOUND get it against MONSTERS and VEHICLES instead

abilities.name: Daemonic Resistance
abilities.community_notes: Defensive: each time an attack targets the unit, subtract 1 from the attacker's Wound roll (modeled attacker-side, as icon-of-obstinacy / rugged-resilience do). Reactive stratagem, used just after an enemy selects targets in the opponent's Shooting or Fight phase.

abilities.name: Immortal Fury
abilities.community_notes: used just after an enemy unit selects your unit as a target; only models that have not fought this phase fight after the attacking unit finishes its attacks

abilities.name: Warp Stalkers
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Move-through excludes enemy MONSTER and VEHICLE models, and a Charge move may end within Engagement Range (both nuances not modeled). Applies to Normal, Advance, Fall Back and Charge moves; the unit must not have been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.

abilities.name: Aspire to Infamy
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] Only the unit's CHARACTER models' melee attacks gain +1 A / +2 S; modeled unit-wide.

abilities.name: Punish the Craven
abilities.community_notes: An enemy unit engaged with your WORLD EATERS CHARACTER that falls back must use desperate escape; if it is battle-shocked, -1 to those hazard rolls.

abilities.name: Rampaging Terrors
abilities.community_notes: [APPROX] The same enemy unit cannot be selected for this effect more than once per phase (cap not modeled). abilities.name: Talons of Butchery
abilities.community_notes: MAULERFIEND unit only. This unit's Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].

abilities.name: Murder-Forged Entity
abilities.community_notes: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model only: the unit gains the DAEMON keyword.

abilities.name: Goaded to Fury
abilities.community_notes: When an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE (excluding TITANIC) has shot, that unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

abilities.name: Adamantine Avalanche
abilities.community_notes: At the start of the Fight phase, if a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD is engaged, make a Blessings of Khorne roll and activate one Blessing of Khorne for friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD units (in addition to any already active).

abilities.name: Gore-Stained Veterans
abilities.community_notes: +1 Weapon Skill on melee attacks, modeled as a WS characteristic modifier (distinct from +1 to Hit; the two stack and must not collide under the single +1-to-Hit cap).

abilities.name: Wrath Beyond Reason

abilities.name: Scorn the Witch

missionCards.name: Battlefield Dominance
missionCards.text: Take-and-Hold mirror. The first two battle rounds reward holding the objective majority at end of turn. From the second battle round, scoring shifts to per-objective control at the end of your Command phase (or end of your turn in the fifth battle round), with a per-objective bonus on your non-home objectives while you also hold your own home objective.

missionCards.name: Determined Acquisition
missionCards.text: Take-and-Hold against Disruption. Every turn pays per objective you took this turn that you did not control at its start. From the second battle round, per-objective control pays at the end of your Command phase, with a stacking per-objective bonus for those inside the opponent's territory.

missionCards.name: Immovable Object
missionCards.text: Take-and-Hold against Purge-the-Foe. Central-objective control pays at the end of every one of your turns. Battle rounds two to four pay heavily per non-home objective at the end of your Command phase; the fifth battle round pays the same rate at the end of your turn instead.

missionCards.name: Inescapable Dominion
missionCards.text: Take-and-Hold against Priority-Assets. Holding three or more objectives pays at the end of your turn. From the second battle round, the Command-phase check pays once for holding two or more objectives and again for holding the objective majority. End of battle pays out for holding the opponent's home objective.

missionCards.name: Purge and Secure
missionCards.text: Take-and-Hold against Reconnaissance. End of turn pays once when a kill touched the objectives: either a friendly unit within range of an objective destroyed an enemy unit, or an enemy unit that started the turn within range of an objective was destroyed (one or the other, not both). From the second battle round, per-objective non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase, and freshly seized non-home objectives pay again at end of turn.

missionCards.name: Unstoppable Force
missionCards.text: Purge-the-Foe against Take-and-Hold. Destroying any enemy unit pays at end of turn. From the second battle round, per-objective non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase, with a separate end-of-turn payout for seizing non-home objectives you did not control at the start of the turn. End of battle rewards holding a central objective.

missionCards.name: Punishment
missionCards.text: Purge-the-Foe against Disruption. At the start of your turn, condemn one to three enemy units that are on objectives and/or destroyed a friendly unit last turn (or any one enemy unit if none qualify); the mark lasts until the start of your next turn. Any condemned unit leaving the battlefield pays at the end of either player's turn. From the second battle round, non-home control and the objective majority each pay at the end of your Command phase. End of battle pays a large bonus for holding the opponent's home objective.

missionCards.name: Meatgrinder
missionCards.text: Purge-the-Foe mirror. Destroying any enemy unit pays at end of turn. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase, while end of turn pays separately for out-killing the opponent (more enemy units destroyed this turn than friendly units lost last turn) and for holding their home objective.

missionCards.name: Destroyer's Wrath
missionCards.text: Purge-the-Foe against Priority-Assets. Destroying any enemy unit pays at end of turn. From the second battle round, the Command-phase check pays for non-home control and pays well for the objective majority, while end of turn pays for out-killing the opponent (more enemy units destroyed this turn than friendly units lost last turn).

missionCards.name: Consecrate
missionCards.text: Purge-the-Foe against Reconnaissance. A friendly unit that destroys an enemy unit becomes a consecration unit; at the end of your turn each consecration unit may consecrate one unconsecrated non-home objective it is within range of, placing one of your operation markers within range. Scoring tiers on consecrated objectives at end of turn (one or two, OR three or more). From the second battle round, non-home control and the objective majority pay at the end of your Command phase. End of battle pays out if the opponent's home objective is consecrated.

missionCards.name: Death Trap
missionCards.text: Disruption against Take-and-Hold. The Booby Trap action (Shooting phase; a friendly unit within range of a non-home objective or within an untrapped terrain area outside your deployment zone; unlimited uses, one terrain area each; completes immediately) traps the terrain area and places one of your operation markers in it. Each terrain area trapped this turn pays out, with a stacking bonus when the trapped terrain is an objective, and a separate payout when an enemy unit that started the turn in trapped terrain was destroyed. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase.

missionCards.name: Outmanoeuvre
missionCards.text: Disruption mirror. Holding the opponent's home objective pays a large amount at the end of any of your turns. Per-objective non-home control escalates as the game goes on: end of your first turn, then end of your Command phase in rounds two and three, then end of your turn from round four at the highest rate.

missionCards.name: Delaying Action
missionCards.text: Disruption against Purge-the-Foe. Every enemy unit destroyed pays at the end of your turn. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase, and holding at least one central objective together with at least one expansion objective pays again at end of turn.

missionCards.name: Locate and Deny
missionCards.text: Disruption against Priority-Assets. At the start of the battle, place one of your operation markers in each of five terrain areas outside your deployment zone (or in every such terrain area if fewer than five). The opponent's Sensor Sweep removes them; your own Sensor Sweep (Shooting phase, a friendly unit within range of a central objective, once per turn, completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective, cannot start while only one marker remains) also removes one marker. Kills on enemy units that started the turn on objectives pay at end of turn, as does being down to exactly one of your markers with a friendly unit alone in its terrain area - the same condition pays again at the end of the battle. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase.

missionCards.name: Smoke and Mirrors
missionCards.text: Disruption against Reconnaissance. The Decoy action (Shooting phase; a friendly unit within range of an undecoyed non-home objective; unlimited uses, one objective each; completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective) decoys the objective and places one of your operation markers within range of it. Each decoyed objective pays at the end of your turn, with a stacking per-objective bonus for those in the opponent's territory. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase. End of battle pays a large bonus if four or more objectives are decoyed.

missionCards.name: Secure Asset
missionCards.text: Priority-Assets against Take-and-Hold. The Secure Asset action (Shooting phase; a friendly unit within range of a non-home objective; once per turn; completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective) secures the asset and pays at end of turn, alongside a payout for destroying enemy units that started the turn on central objectives. From the second battle round, the Command-phase check pays for non-home control and again for holding three or more objectives.

missionCards.name: Extract Relic
missionCards.text: Priority-Assets against Disruption. Your Sensor Sweep action (Shooting phase, a friendly unit within range of a central objective, once per turn, completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective, cannot start while only one operation marker remains on the battlefield) removes one of the opponent's operation markers and pays at end of turn. Kills on enemy units that started the turn on objectives also pay, as does whittling the opponent down to exactly one marker with a friendly unit alone in its terrain area - that condition pays again at the end of the battle. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase.

missionCards.name: Vital Link
missionCards.text: Priority-Assets against Purge-the-Foe. The Maintain Control action (Shooting phase, a friendly unit within range of a central objective, once per turn, completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective) places one of your operation markers within range of that objective. Central control pays at end of turn with a stacking bonus per marker within range of a controlled central objective. From the second battle round, the Command-phase check pays for non-home control with a stacked bonus when one of those is a central objective. End of battle pays a large bonus for holding the opponent's home objective.

missionCards.name: Sabotage
missionCards.text: Priority-Assets mirror. The Sabotage action (Shooting phase; a unit within range of a non-home objective; unlimited uses, one objective each; completes at end of turn if that unit controls that objective) commits sabotage. Each saboteur pays at the end of your turn, with a stacking per-unit bonus for saboteurs within range of objectives in the opponent's territory. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase.

missionCards.name: Vanguard Operation
missionCards.text: Priority-Assets against Reconnaissance. The Vanguard Operation action (Shooting phase; a friendly unit within one terrain area inside the opponent's territory; once per turn; completes at end of turn if no enemy units are within that terrain area) pays at end of turn, alongside a smaller payout for destroying any enemy unit. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase. End of battle pays a large bonus for holding the opponent's home objective.

missionCards.name: Reconnaissance Sweep
missionCards.text: Reconnaissance against Take-and-Hold. Spread out: three or more friendly units wholly within three different table quarters (none within 6 inches of the battlefield centre) pays at end of turn, with a higher tier for four units across four quarters - only the better tier scores. Each enemy unit destroyed pays a small amount. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase.

missionCards.name: Surveil the Foe
missionCards.text: Reconnaissance against Disruption. Whenever a friendly unit ends a move within range of an objective that has any of the opponent's operation markers within range, those markers are removed. The Surveil the Foe action (Shooting phase, one friendly unit, unlimited uses, completes immediately) surveils one visible enemy unit within 18 inches that has not been surveilled this turn. Surveilled enemy units pay at end of turn - unless every one of them is within range of an objective shielded by operation markers. From the second battle round, the Command-phase check pays for non-home control and for the objective majority, and end of turn pays out while none of the opponent's markers remain on the battlefield.

missionCards.name: Triangulation
missionCards.text: Reconnaissance against Purge-the-Foe. The Triangulate action (Shooting phase from the second battle round onwards; a friendly unit within range of a non-home objective; once per turn; completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective) triangulates the objective and places one of your operation markers within range. From the second battle round, non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase, and end of turn pays a tier on how many objectives are triangulated (one, two, OR three or more - only the highest tier scores). End of battle pays a large bonus for holding four or more objectives.

missionCards.name: Search and Scour
missionCards.text: Reconnaissance against Priority-Assets. Central-objective control pays at end of turn, alongside a payout for destroying enemy units that started the turn inside a terrain area. From the second battle round, per-objective non-home control pays at the end of your Command phase. End of battle pays out if no enemy units are wholly within your territory.

missionCards.name: Gather Intel
missionCards.text: Reconnaissance mirror. The first battle round pays well for holding a central objective at end of turn. The Extract Intelligence action (Shooting phase from the second battle round onwards; a unit within range of a non-home objective with none of your operation markers within range of it; unlimited uses, one objective each; completes at end of turn if the unit controls that objective) places one of your operation markers within range of that objective, and each completed action pays heavily at end of turn. From the second battle round non-home control also pays at the end of your Command phase. End of battle pays twice: for three or more of your markers on the battlefield, and for a marker within range of the opponent's home objective.

missionCards.name: Forward Position
missionCards.text: Break through and hold forward ground. Score the payout at the end of your turn while you control the opponent's home objective and/or an expansion objective. If drawn in the first battle round, draw one new card and shuffle this card back into your deck.

missionCards.name: Burden of Trust
missionCards.text: When drawn and at the start of each of your turns, you can select one friendly unit per objective to guard it; until the start of your next turn, while that unit is within range of the objective and you control it, the objective is guarded. Score per guarded objective at the end of your opponent's turn or the end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first, up to a ceiling of 5 VP.

missionCards.name: Display of Might
missionCards.text: Dominate the middle of the table with bodies. Score the smaller payout at the end of your turn, or the larger one at the end of the opponent's turn, while more friendly units than enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are wholly within No Man's Land.

missionCards.name: Assassination
missionCards.text: Hunt enemy leaders. Fixed play scores per enemy CHARACTER model destroyed each turn, with a stacking bonus for each that had a Wounds characteristic of 4 or more. Tactical play instead pays a flat amount when one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this turn, or when all enemy CHARACTER models have been destroyed during the battle.

missionCards.name: Centre Ground
missionCards.text: Own the middle. At the end of your turn, score the lower amount while one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 3 inches of the centre of the battlefield with no enemy units within 3 inches of it, or the higher amount when no enemy units are within 6 inches of the centre. Only the better tier scores.

missionCards.name: Outflank
missionCards.text: Sweep the flanks. At the end of your turn, score the lower amount while one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 6 inches of one or more battlefield edges and not within your territory, or the higher amount when two or more such units are within 6 inches of opposite battlefield edges (edges parallel to each other) and at least one of them is not within your territory. Only the better tier scores.

missionCards.name: Plunder
missionCards.text: Strip the field of its prizes. The Plunder action (Shooting phase; one unit within a terrain area that is not within your territory; once per turn; completes immediately) plunders that terrain area. Score the payout at the end of your turn if a terrain area was plundered this turn. If the Cleanse mission is active for you when this is drawn, draw one new card and shuffle this card back into your deck.

missionCards.name: Engage on All Fronts
missionCards.text: Spread your presence across the table. You have a presence in a table quarter while one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are wholly within it and not within 6 inches of the centre of the battlefield. At the end of your turn, score by presence in three quarters or the higher tier for four; only the better tier scores. Tactical values are higher than fixed.

missionCards.name: Secure No Man's Land
missionCards.text: Seize the middle ground. Score the payout at the end of your turn while you control two or more objectives within No Man's Land, not counting your home objective.

missionCards.name: No Prisoners
missionCards.text: Give no quarter. Score per enemy unit destroyed this turn, evaluated at the end of a turn, up to a ceiling of 5 VP.

missionCards.name: Bring It Down
missionCards.text: Bring down the big targets. Score per enemy model with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more destroyed this turn, evaluated at the end of a turn; tactical play scores more per kill but caps at 5 VP. If there are no such enemy models on the battlefield when drawn, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

missionCards.name: Overwhelming Force
missionCards.text: Clear the objectives by force. Score per enemy unit that started the turn within range of one or more objectives and was destroyed, evaluated at the end of a turn, up to a ceiling of 5 VP.

missionCards.name: Cleanse
missionCards.text: Purify tainted ground. The Cleanse action (Shooting phase; one friendly unit within range of a non-home objective; unlimited uses, one objective each; completes at end of turn if that unit is controlling that objective) cleanses that objective this turn. At the end of your turn, score the lower amount for one objective cleansed by your army this turn or the higher amount for two or more; only the better tier scores. If the Plunder mission is active for you when this is drawn, draw one new card and shuffle this card back into your deck.

missionCards.name: Behind Enemy Lines
missionCards.text: Push into the enemy backfield. Score per friendly unit (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within the opponent's deployment zone, evaluated at the end of your turn, up to a ceiling of 5 VP. If drawn in the first battle round, draw one new card and shuffle this card back into your deck.

missionCards.name: Defend Stronghold
missionCards.text: Hold what is yours. From the second battle round, at the end of your opponent's turn or the end of the fifth battle round (whichever comes first), score for controlling your home objective, with a stacking bonus while no enemy units are within your deployment zone. If drawn in the first battle round, draw one new card and shuffle this card back into your deck.

missionCards.name: A Tempting Target
missionCards.text: When drawn, your opponent selects one objective (excluding home objectives) within No Man's Land to be your tempting target. Score the payout at the end of your turn while you control your tempting target.

missionCards.name: A Grievous Blow
missionCards.text: Shatter the horde. Score per enemy unit with a Starting Strength of 13 or more destroyed this turn, evaluated at the end of a turn; tactical play scores more per kill but caps at 5 VP. If there are no such enemy units on the battlefield when drawn, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

missionCards.name: Beacon
missionCards.text: Send your champion into enemy-held ground. When drawn, designate one friendly unit on the battlefield (or embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield) as your beacon unit. Score at the end of your opponent's turn — or the end of the fifth battle round, whichever comes first — 3 VP if the beacon unit is on the battlefield and not within your deployment zone, or 5 VP if it is on the battlefield and not within your territory; score only the better tier.
